name: 20815 · Chevy Chase, MD
findings: ZIP 20815 (Chevy Chase) has 267 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20815 (Chevy Chase) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do research and think tank organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 63 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20815 (Chevy Chase) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?
